nativeCrypto: matrix-sdk-crypto-nodejs OlmMachine; real persistent encrypted store and Megolm encryption/decryption
assertions: Committed outbox SENT state survives restart and event replay
Text worker and media dispatcher cannot reprepare/resend committed work
Only one native encryption per status
Lost-response retry uses identical encrypted bytes and transaction ID
Accepted status decrypts after crypto-store reopening
Status timestamp and original-event mapping retained across repeated application

limitations: Outbound Threema results are seeded; native send/upload interruption not tested.
Matrix transport/acceptance is synthetic; no live homeserver or cross-device room-key distribution.
Audio and video use file-fallback outbox projection records. Codec pipeline is not exercised.
Journal acknowledgement and pending UI behavior remain separate from durable encrypted sent-status recovery.
New fixture is staged for future builds and is not included in exported migration images.
